one_line: Free, open-source WordPress e-commerce plugin with a REST API for managing products, orders, customers, and store data.
auth_notes: REST API key = consumer key + consumer secret generated per user in the WordPress admin (WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API); authenticated via HTTP Basic Auth (key as username, secret as password) or OAuth 1.0a one-legged; also an application-auth endpoint for key exchange.
self_serve_notes: Fully free and self-serve: install WordPress + WooCommerce (open source), then generate consumer key/secret from the admin. Requires hosting the store yourself.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: v3 REST API with 30+ top-level resources (products, orders, customers, coupons, shipping, taxes, reports, webhooks, refunds, attributes, variations, etc.)
api_surface.webhook_note: First-class webhooks resource; subscribe to order/product/customer lifecycle topics delivered to HTTPS endpoints

existing_mcp.note: No official WooCommerce MCP server; multiple community MCP servers exist on GitHub/MCP registries

evidence.note: Fetched text (full REST API docs) confirms consumer key/secret, HTTP Basic Auth, OAuth 1.0a, webhooks resource, REST API keys generation

agent_notes: Self-hosted: a dev must stand up a WooCommerce store to get credentials, but it's free and un-gated. Auth is simple key-based.
